property_summary: For any cooler clone c created with immutable args containing distinct owner and collateral addresses, c.owner() must equal the owner address encoded at offset 0x0; the mutant returns the collateral address at 0x14 instead, failing when owner ≠ collateral.
change_summary: Change the offset argument to _getArgAddress from 0x0 to 0x14 so owner returns the collateral address instead of the owner address.
